note: Golden vectors of src/coinmeta-v2.js (stage S22, as fixed in its review): one pair-independent content per city version (contentJson, contentHash) and its rendering for each quote (description, metadataJson, metaHash, uri). Places are the city list's unless marked FAKE, with the SHA-256 of public/data/cities.json at edabab5 as the list version; every mint and upload hash is fake, one mint per city, except the t2 picture hashes, which are the real t2 PNGs of src/coinart-t2.js for that ticker and coin name (resvg-wasm 2.6.2). Regenerating this file means a new version, never an edit.
